legend: Let's write all the positive integer numbers one after another from 1$$$1$$$ without any delimiters (i.e. as a single string). It will be the infinite sequence starting with 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536...
Your task is to print the k$$$k$$$-th digit of this sequence.
input: The first and only line contains integer k$$$k$$$ (1≤k≤1012$$$1 \le k \le 10^{12}$$$) — the position to process (1$$$1$$$-based index).
output: Print the k$$$k$$$-th digit of the resulting infinite sequence.
